acquisition method: DDA-MBR were performed with MS tolerance of 10 ppm
enrichment method: incubated on a turning wheel at 4 °C with 12.5 µl pre-equilibrated ALFA beads... incubated for 10 min rotating at 4 °C together with 12.5 µl pre-equilibrated GFP-Trap beads
instrument: connected to a TimsTOF HT mass spectrometer (Bruker Corporation, Bremen)
ionization type: Eluted peptides were directly electro sprayed into the mass spectrometer
precursor tolerance: DDA-MBR were performed with MS tolerance of 10 ppm
ptm: Carbamidomethylation (C) and oxidation (M) were chosen as modifications.
